status.evidence: According to the company's official website, Navstar Tracking operates as a brand of Telco NE Ltd, which was incorporated in 2023 and lists its headquarters at The Workspace Office 6 in Gateshead.

claims.claim: The company reports that its core system delivers live GPS tracking, driver behaviour reporting, and live video streaming supporting up to 2 Terabytes of memory storage when paired with its LiveCam mobile CCTV solution, as detailed by partner Telco NE Vehicle Tracking.
claims.source: Telco NE Vehicle Tracking Product Page (https://telco-ne.co.uk/what-we-do/vehicle-tracking/)

claims.claim: The company reports that its technology offerings include 4G/GPS Vehicle WiFi Devices alongside its core real-time tracking software, as stated in the Navstar Tracking Privacy Policy.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its technology offerings include 4G/GPS Vehicle WiFi Devices alongside its core real-time tracking software, as stated on the Our Products page of the Navstar Tracking website.

claims.claim: The company reports offering the GB100 tracking unit, an insurance telematics device equipped with an internal 3-axis accelerometer for incident notification and driver behavior monitoring, which mounts directly to a vehicle's battery to allow for low-cost installation or customer self-fitting.

The company reports offering the Navstar IncidentCam, a connected 4G LTE dash camera featuring a 120-degree wide-angle view, 720p/1080p high-definition video streaming, and serial port connectivity designed to work alongside telematics devices such as the CalAmp LMU 2720.

Financial records filed with the UK Companies House via Company Check show that Wardair Direct Limited, the operating corporate entity behind Navstar Tracking, registered a net worth of £821,375 and cash holdings of £1,136,341 for the 2022 reporting period.
claims.source: Company Check Profile for Wardair Direct Limited (https://companycheck.co.uk/company/04113073/WARDAIR-DIRECT-LIMITED/companies-house-data)

claims.claim: Wardair Direct Limited operates as Navstar's primary sister company and mobile channel partner, serving as the developer and merchant for the Navstar Tracking application on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
claims.source: Apple App Store (Navstar Tracking), Google Play Store (Navstar Tracking), and official company context linking Wardair Direct Limited and Navstar Vehicle Tracking.

claims.claim: Telco NE Ltd, the operator of Navstar Vehicle Tracking, maintains a strategic telecommunications network partnership with O2 to distribute its connected fleet telemetry and mobile data tariffs.
claims.note: strategic telecommunications network partnership with O2

claims.claim: The company reports offering its basic GO GPS vehicle tracking self-fit systems starting from £60 ex.VAT and £6.50 per month on its official product website.
claims.note: basic GO GPS vehicle tracking self-fit systems starting from £60 ex.VAT
claims.source: Navstar Official Website & Telco NE Product Pages

claims.claim: The company reports its main headquarters office is located at Office 6, The Workspace, The Fed, Lancaster Road, Gateshead, United Kingdom.
claims.source: Navstar Tracking Contact Page & Telco NE Corporate Contact Information
